description: Northern Province - The Supplementary Provision for Appropriation Statute No. 05 of 2015 of Northern Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a provincial statute (Northern Province Appropriation Statute (Supplementary Provisions) No. 05 of 2015) that provides supplementary financial provisions and reallocates funds for the 2015 financial year. It involves legal/regulatory matters including statutory enactment, financial authorizations, and amendments to previous appropriation limits, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation.
